rules: Private property only unless you have a city/county/MnDOT permit.
Never put signs in the public right-of-way of trunk highways without authorization.
Get homeowner OK; log name/phone/affiliation when known.
Highest ROI: yards visible from MnDOT/CSAH arterials AND within ~0.5 mi of polling places.
